digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / model escalation and sizing
propositions: models_at_or_above() returns the full ladder for a non-located primary instead of the primary itself, causing escalation to downgrade to smaller-window models and jump to a different provider family

largest_window_tokens() returns the ladder maximum (1000000) for an unlocated primary instead of the ladder minimum (200000), causing P8 to under-block and allow truncation instead of rejecting oversized input
prerequisite-coverage escalation in prerequisites.py:260-263 inherits the downgrade defect because it consumes models_at_or_above() and takes ladder[0] for an unlocated primary
the defect is invisible on the default configuration (claude-opus-4-8) but affects all operators who set REBAR_LLM_MODEL to a non-Anthropic-family model
